title: Text: DET Drew VerHagen ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Nothing, hope your off-season is going well. I have to write about Mientkiewicz firing and was looking for a player’s perspective. Way off-record, not for use, but what was he like? Essentially, they  thought he had too much fire, a little too intense.
Man I’d rather not throw him under the bus. I will say he wasn’t a good fit for the young triple a team that he had. The year before we were older and he was awesome
Hey, that’s great info. Thanks for getting back to me on it. Not trying to throw him under the bus, just write something that’s fair to both sides. Appreciate it. Again, not quoting you or anything
People are wondering why they gave him a 2-year deal after last year and then fired him after this year. I wasn’t thinking of the make-up of the team
